body:
Added admins.manage (Top-Admin-only, gates modifying/disabling admin-tier accounts) and providers.manage (Provider Admin grants/revokes Provider Operator role) permissions, IsOperatorAdmin/IsProviderAdmin fields, and full tier-guard enforcement in users.go. Extended sip-accounts.provision to SipAccountsHandler with the same created_by minimum-necessary scoping mail_account_credentials already has. 15 new tests, go build/vet/test ./... clean. commit 053dc88.

⚓ ☃
title: 4-tier RBAC hierarchy (Top/Operator Admin, Provider Admin/Operator) + SIP provider scoping
